scope: Current Backlog dependency snapshot; not implementation or physical acceptance

tasks.title: Reconcile SAT low-load question, decision and task evidence records
ac: LL-023 distinguishes desired, implemented, host-tested and physically verified states; dated history and verbatim designer quotations remain intact.

Q35/Q38/Q40/Q44/Q46/Q47 and provisional Q48-Q51 have non-overlapping choices, source citations and explicit approval/revisit triggers; no unsupported probability or ancestry claim survives in current guidance.

TASK-1373 uses ID49 bounds, ID57 value and ID6 support/writability; TASK-1385 is revalidated against TASK-1401 before any duplicate fix; historical TASK-14/16/43/1268/1277 closure claims have attributed current-status annotations.
Existing asking order and one-question-at-a-time policy are preserved unless Robert changes them; unresolved decisions remain unresolved and linked to their implementation tasks.

tasks.title: Establish reviewed OT low-load requirements and scoped decision contracts
ac: A clause-to-behaviour-to-test crosswalk distinguishes mandatory OT requirements, suggested low-load recipes, recorded SAT decisions and new proposals; each selected implementation path has an unambiguous contract.
Decision entries listed in remediation section 2 are checked individually for agreement; any conflict is cited and queued for Sergeant D, with no fabricated resolution or accepted-ADR edits.
Unknown support, invalid reply, missing sample, source identity and sample age are separate states; manual source selection and ownership/cutoff rules remain explicit.
Each control-change task identifies its own required approval; unresolved policy blocks only affected implementation and the corresponding validation claim.

tasks.title: Add executable low-load contract regressions before implementation fixes
ac: LL-001..004 and contract fixtures for LL-010..023 execute real production functions or integrated production code; approved expectations and undecided alternatives are clearly separated.
Baseline defects are reproduced with timestamped input/output and source hashes; missing tools/tests exit distinctly from a passing test.
Fix tasks can run focused red/green scenarios without disabling unrelated assertions; release mode rejects expectedFailure, skipped mandatory scenarios and missing evidence.

tasks.title: Honor slave low-load permission across SAT entry and active PWM
ac: LL-010 covers ID3 HB4 permission, unknown/changed permission, every automatic/manual entry and active-PWM response under the approved contract.
A slave veto cannot be bypassed by another entry path; manual gas/HP/hybrid selection remains authoritative under ADR-157.
Host traces prove requested and transmitted master bits separately; the design defines safe fallback and re-entry before implementation.

tasks.title: Make SAT flow and return measurement validity and age explicit
ac: LL-011 distinguishes unsupported, never received, Data-Invalid, stale, fresh zero and valid values for ID25/ID28 on PIC and OT-Direct.
A live link with stale flow cannot masquerade as fresh feedback; approved stale-data fallback and recovery are deterministic.
Timestamp traces measure source sample age plus scheduler/queue/wire delay against reviewed transport budgets; infeasible fallback is rejected for that profile.

tasks.title: Separate PWM phase actuation from overshoot protection enablement
ac: LL-017 exercises protection toggles during continuous, PWM ON, PWM OFF, startup and recovery.
An approved mode contract preserves OFF-phase actuation or explicitly rejects the unsupported combination; disabling a setting cannot silently bypass phase ownership.
No change to CH/cold-cutoff/ownership semantics is inferred without the required recorded decision.

tasks.title: Correct low-load entry qualification and post-DHW recovery
ac: LL-012 covers startup, setpoint fall, maximum-temperature limiting, pump/valve changes, DHW tails and real minimum-capacity saturation.
The approved entry evidence distinguishes a temperature proxy from confirmed low-load operation; application 2.2.3 recovery and current inhibit timing are compared explicitly.
DHW/flame edges do not move phase-owned timers; master CH-enable and slave CH-mode are tested as different signals.

tasks.title: Make SAT low-load exits correct across long and jittered scheduler intervals
ac: Q44/Q46/Q47 decisions are recorded before changing exit duration, saturation/underheat accumulation or action order.
LL-004 tests every supported tick including >60 s, delayed calls, jitter, same-update transitions and timer rollover against the chosen elapsed-time contract.
A transition takes effect on the approved update; unsupported probability claims are replaced by reproducible traces.

tasks.title: Revalidate PWM start counting and phase duration policy after anchor fixes
ac: LL-019 covers P versus 2P, zero ON, first entry, range 5, DHW, delayed/failed ignition, relight, limit windows and timestamp rollover.
Q48-Q51 provisional decisions are explicitly revisited after Q35 changes, with maintainer/designer provenance preserved.
Commanded phase durations, counted starts and observed burner/compressor runtimes are separate outputs; no unconditional 180 s flame guarantee is asserted.

tasks.title: Verify SAT PID startup, held derivative and saturation semantics
ac: LL-003/020 cover main and area PID, approved startup/restore output, 10/30/60/long actuator calls, scheduler outages and no catch-up integral burst.
Deadband/reset boundaries, Ki=0, persistence, rounding, dynamic gain times held raw derivative and actuator saturation are characterized from the real implementation.
Only approved Q23-Q28 policy changes are implemented; a proposed alternative anti-windup/controller is a separate decision, not an incidental fix.

tasks.title: Make SAT command delivery and latest-state recovery verifiable
ac: LL-013 records logical intent, enqueue result, actual frame transmission and available acknowledgement as separate events on PIC and OT-Direct.
Queue-full, interrupted exchange, reset, superseded commands and recovery retain/retry the latest approved state; rejected enqueue is never reported delivered.
CS/MM/CH update deadlines, suppression service and ordinary OT traffic coexist within measured budgets; PIC echoes are not treated as boiler acceptance.

tasks.title: Validate missing-return ignition and runtime startup on both transports
ac: LL-018 executes the approved no-return startup contract with unsupported/invalid/stale return, runtime enable and hot-boiler anti-cycle lockout.
Entry45 and Q40 interpretation is recorded before implementation; actual sample age and ignition sequence are compared with the application specification.
PIC MI/PM behaviour and OT-Direct equivalents are proven separately; a replay or command echo cannot close physical ignition acceptance.

tasks.title: Verify MaxTSet negotiation and every transmitted SAT ceiling
ac: LL-014 verifies ID49 bounds, ID57 value, ID6 support/writability and unsupported/rejected/write-readback cases.
Ignition, refresh, continuous, PWM and recovery paths never exceed the effective approved user/equipment ceiling.
Stored user limits persist; device measurements and transient support state are not persisted as settings.

tasks.title: Prove classifier input parity before cycle-end mode switching
ac: LL-021 runs the real pinned upstream and port classifiers on identical timestamped samples including changing CS and mode mid-burn.
Per-sample requested/control CS, warm-up exclusion, percentile interpolation, missing-data treatment, boundary margin and label deviations are explicitly verified.
RAM cost is measured; TASK-1331 cannot resume until input parity and approved deviations pass.

tasks.title: Validate SAT telemetry against independent event and wire evidence
ac: LL-022 compares MM value/units, ON/OFF seconds, cycle off-gaps and rolling duty metrics with independent timestamped frames/events.
Zero-gap, boot-existing-flame, DHW overlap, missing samples and window expiry cannot create fabricated duty or modulation values.
Telemetry used for bench/field scoring passes this gate before those runs; it is not its own evidence oracle.

tasks.title: Quantify repaired SAT duty and PID behaviour against controlled plant models
ac: LL-016 compares the temperature-ratio estimate with integrated heat delivery, room error and actual start events across fixed/variable flow and radiator/low-temperature plant models.
The repaired SAT baseline is compared under identical scenarios with suitable bounded PI/TPI and native weather/room-influence baselines; model limits and parameter sensitivity are published.
No energy/COP/comfort improvement or new algorithm approval is inferred from simulation alone; a controller replacement requires a separate approved ADR/task.

tasks.title: Define equipment-specific gas, heat-pump and hybrid commissioning profiles
ac: PH-PROFILE/LL-015 require source/emitter/native-control mode, interface capabilities, minimum output, ON/OFF/start limits, hydraulic limits, temperature ceiling and measurement availability.
Q37/Q45 and entry21/52 exceptions are resolved for each included profile; unknown compressor protections block that heat-pump claim.
Native defrost/DHW/backup protections and explicit hand-back/rollback are documented; gas MM0 evidence is not generalized to heat pumps.

tasks.title: Pass the complete SAT low-load host and production integration gate
ac: LL-001..004 and LL-010..023 software portions pass together against the candidate commit with no mandatory skip/expectedFailure; unresolved affected policy is a blocker.
Real scheduling, production control, transport queues, ownership and sensor-loss/recovery are exercised together, beyond isolated extracted-function tests.
Project checklist/build/evaluate/relevant regression results and commit/config/source/test hashes are archived; physical gates remain explicitly pending.

tasks.title: Pass reproducible closed-loop low-load simulation before hardware bench
ac: The candidate production controller runs against documented plant models for very low load, thermal lag, minimum power, pump/TRV changes, DHW, delayed ignition and sensor/transport faults.
Pre-registered comfort, cycling, temperature and protection thresholds pass across parameter ranges and seeded fault runs; exact inputs/seeds/raw traces are reproducible.
Simulation limitations and failed scenarios are recorded; no simulator result is labeled physical boiler or compressor proof.

tasks.title: Prepare and calibrate an isolated SAT real-board bench simulator
ac: A real ESP32-S3 board drives a safe emulated OT slave/plant on PIC and OT-Direct paths, with actual transport identity verified and no live heating equipment required.
Injected support/veto/invalid/stale data, ignition/lockout delays, DHW and queue faults are timestamped by an independent capture; simulator timing and instrumentation are calibrated.
A versioned operator procedure, fixtures, expected outputs and rollback/reset check allow another operator to repeat the bench scenarios.

tasks.title: Execute SAT low-load real-board bench simulation on PIC and OT-Direct
ac: Both PIC gateway and OT-Direct candidate firmware pass the versioned bench scenario matrix using emulated loads before any tester field run.
Independent captures verify commanded CH/CS/MM, deadlines, phase/ignition anchors, veto, limits, faults and recovery; firmware/FS/settings/simulator/instrument identities are archived.
A failed scenario blocks bench acceptance; fixes rerun the failed scenarios and relevant integrated regressions on the new candidate.

tasks.title: Approve bench evidence and authorize controlled equipment validation readiness
ac: An independent reviewer checks both bench transport reports against all applicable LL scenarios and pre-registered thresholds; missing evidence or unexplained failures block acceptance.
The exact accepted firmware/FS/configuration and scope are recorded; a later control change invalidates affected acceptance and requires rerun.
Bench evidence proves board/protocol behaviour only; the signed readiness record is a mandatory prerequisite to equipment commissioning and tester field-validation tasks.

tasks.title: Commission accepted SAT candidate on controlled real heating equipment
ac: PH-PIC/PH-OTD pass for claimed transport/equipment combinations with independent actual flame/compressor state, temperature/flow and command timestamps.
Actual ignition/relight, minimum runtime/lockout, low-load veto, ceiling, sensor faults, DHW/defrost/native protections and hand-back are verified within manufacturer limits.
Unsupported/unavailable combinations remain excluded; stop/rollback criteria are demonstrated, and physical results cannot be substituted by simulated traces.

tasks.title: Prepare tester field protocol and readiness after bench and equipment acceptance
ac: A named-equipment tester pack contains accepted artifacts, setup/calibration, measurement schema, limits, stop/rollback instructions and reporting templates.
Matched A/B or B/A periods and weather/comfort/energy uncertainty controls are pre-registered, including DHW/defrost/backup and hydraulic configuration.
Readiness explicitly records bench and controlled-equipment acceptance; recruiting/contacting testers requires Robert's authorization and is not performed by this planning task.

tasks.title: Run authorized matched SAT tester field validation and publish measurements
ac: Only authorized testers with accepted equipment/profile and bench-approved candidate run the pre-registered PH-FIELD protocol.
Raw measurements, weather/room comfort, heat/fuel/electricity, start/runtime, DHW/defrost/backup, settings and uncertainty are retained; matched comparisons include native control where applicable.
Failures trigger stop/rollback and affected bench reruns before redeployment; no cost-only result is described as COP/energy improvement.

tasks.title: Independently verify SAT low-load implementation and release evidence
ac: A second reviewer opens cited upstream/current locations and challenges claimed differences; all R01-R42 have evidence-backed closure or explicit release exclusion.
Release acceptance validates LL-001..004, LL-010..023 and PH-PIC/OTD/PROFILE/FIELD evidence for the exact candidate; absent physical evidence, expected failures and unapproved decisions fail closed.
Supported combinations, residual limitations, benchmark results and rollback proof are published; documentation agrees with measured implementation and the project checklist is complete.
Only after this gate passes may TASK-1412 be marked Done; required task commits are narrow and pushed to the configured upstream.
